name: Okoze Arika
source:
A vigorous girl who is related to [url=https://vndb.org/c22769]Mashiro[/url]. Like Mayu, she is someone who likes to swing "that way." A lively girl who is Mashiro's childhood friend and rival. Because they both decided to take different paths in life (and also because of some mutual awkwardness between them), their chances of remaining close greatly decreased.

[Taken from [url=https://aokanatranslation.wordpress.com/game-info/side-characters/]AoKana Translation Page[/url]]
